sn38.15:1.8: “But, reverend, what is the path and what is the practice for completely understanding this substantial reality?”
sn38.15:1.9: “This, reverend, is the noble eightfold path for completely understanding this substantial reality, that is—
sn38.15:1.11: This, reverend, is the path, this is the practice for completely understanding this substantial reality.”
sn38.15:1.12: “This path is good, reverend, this practice is better, for completely understanding this substantial reality.
sn38.15:1.13: And, reverend Sāriputta, don’t be heedless.”
